purpose: Familiar everyday vocabulary that can support currently unused approved words, following the owner's rejection of the previous batch's uncommonness.
method: Forty-nine independently validated examples contain one proposal and four already-approved partners. The basil example contains two proposals, რეჰანი and ჰიენა, and three approved partners. Each includes an unused active-revision word. Existing board validation checks crossings, exact tiles, five answers, two long answers, landscape dimensions, density and phone cell size.
limitations: Forty-one senses are approved and nine rejected. Together with batch 03, 51 approvals await integration. Active revision 28 remains unchanged. The isolated generation experiment separately evaluates campaign capacity.
sourceAttribution: Source links and content hashes are retained per word. Brief original English glosses only; full source definitions are not republished.
